hooks.command: bash -c 'file=$(jq -r '\''.tool_input.file_path // empty'\'' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$file" ] && echo "$file" | grep -qE '\''\.(tsx|ts)$'\''; then if grep -q '\'' — '\'' "$file" 2>/dev/null; then echo "ERROR: em dash found in $file — remove it before continuing"; exit 1; fi; fi'
bash -c 'cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)}/apps/web" && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20; exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}'
bash -c 'osascript -e '\''display notification "Claude Code is done" with title "Foxing"'\'' 2>/dev/null || notify-send '\''Foxing'\'' '\''Claude Code is done'\'' 2>/dev/null || true'
